sms: Start pivot today. Flash drought chance 13% vs 4% normal. Worth $5.6/acre avg to start now.
note: Verdict: start the pivot today. Flash drought risk is 13% vs 4% normal, about 3.1 times normal. Soil moisture is at 54th percentile and Drought Monitor is D0 abnormally dry. Risk stays 11% in the week after. Starting today is worth $5.6 per acre on average vs waiting for crop stress, and $85 per acre if flash drought hits. Waiting 2 days for next forecast is worth $4.8 per acre. Lower risk or wetter soil would change it.

status.how_to_read: value_* are average dollars per acre against starting the pivot the usual way (after the crop shows stress); negative means starting today costs more in pumping than it saves on average. The loss avoided is what a week's warning saves if a flash drought does come.
